question: What was the total number of gold medals won by India at Commonwealth Games 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**26.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• India won a total of **26 gold medals** at Commonwealth Games 2018
 
• With **26 Gold medals**, **20 Silver medals** and **20 Bronze medals**, and a total of** 66 medals**, India finished **3rd **for the tournament.
 
• The 2018 Commonwealth Games was hosted by **Australia**. They were held in **Gold Coast, Queensland.**
 
• The official mascot for the 2018 Commonwealth Games is a **koala **named **Borobi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
